strings: explicit artist-concept subject: an original unbranded orbital megastructure whose rotation axis, modular habitation, construction trusses, energy collection and nearby vehicles make mechanics and scale coherent

The subject is an original artist-concept orbital megastructure with rotation axis, habitation modules, assembly trusses, energy collection and nearby vehicle scale.
Artist concept does not prove real engineering feasibility or a particular impossible law; no planet, brand or human population is specified.

Armbands are uncarried inventory unless worn state is declared; no credential text, real authority or actual evacuation follows.

A transit frame connects system boundary, anchored waiting position, vehicle or door state, luggage and travel direction.
Platform, gate, curb and stop are alternatives; direction does not prove actual arrival, departure or waiting persons emotion.
네거티브 필; negative fill; 기존 키는 유지; 반대 반사광 감소
Negative fill reduces opposite-side reflected light on face or clothing shadows while preserving the existing key.
This is not merely lowering whole-image exposure, changing the key or inferring sexual styling from research tags.

Head count is anatomical rather than participant count; snake bundles, duplicate bodies and a three-headed dog do not substitute.
